spec.title: Pipeline stage transitions (15m rate, by stage/outcome/reason)
spec.description: The single most useful panel for finding the last stage a stuck message reached — filterable by stage.

spec.title: Storage / gRPC errors (rate)
spec.description: Should sit at ~0.

spec.title: Disablement-rules refresh failure ratio
spec.description: Sustained non-zero means the aggregator is working off stale disablement rules.

spec.title: Top 10 oldest pending messages by lane
spec.description: Multiple lanes lit up = shared infrastructure issue, not a single lane's problem.

spec.title: Aggregator's view of verifier score
spec.description: MAD-based lag vs. the committee (CalculateAdaptiveScore): 1.0 = leading/no issues, 2.0 = 1 MAD behind, 4.0 = 3 MADs behind — investigate beyond that.

spec.title: Chain head lag (latest - safe / latest - finalized)
spec.description: Widening gap = the source RPC is behind or finality stalled upstream, not in our verifier.

spec.title: Global curse state
spec.description: Should be OK — CURSED is a hard stop, not a warning.

spec.title: Aggregator-side heartbeat freshness (s since last heartbeat, per caller_id)
spec.description: Amber >60s, red >300s. Stale or absent means that verifier isn't reporting.

spec.title: Messages pending finality
spec.description: Growing = lane-wide finality blockage.

spec.title: Message failures (15m rate, by stage/retryable/error_class)
spec.description: Expect no rows in a healthy environment — this counter has no live series until the first real failure.

spec.title: Oldest pending message age
spec.description: Red line = 15m runbook alert threshold.

spec.title: Reader progress vs. chain finality
spec.description: Verifier's own processing lag once the chain has finalized blocks.

spec.title: Reader state by chain
spec.description: States: running, poll_error, finality_blocked, disabled.

spec.title: Time since last successful poll
spec.description: Only meaningful during poll_error; climbs unbounded on a stalled reader.

spec.title: Verifier heartbeat score
spec.description: MAD-based lag vs. the committee (CalculateAdaptiveScore): 1.0 = leading/no issues, 2.0 = 1 MAD behind, 4.0 = 3 MADs behind — investigate beyond that.

spec.title: End-to-end message latency
spec.description: Shows how long messages normally take — context for judging whether 15m is actually anomalous.

spec.title: Verification queue size
spec.description: Sustained growth = verification can't keep up with intake.

spec.title: Verification queue latency (p95)
spec.description: Time spent waiting before verification starts.

spec.title: Storage write / query duration (p95)
spec.description: Storage-layer latency, isolates DB from verification logic.

spec.title: Completed aggregations / verifications (rate)
spec.description: Baseline throughput.

spec.title: Pending aggregations channel buffer
spec.description: Backpressure indicator — climbing means aggregation can't keep up with incoming verifications.
